added_features.QE: base plus exact-solver features and shared coverageflags
added_features.QG: base plus full11motif frequency vector plus shared mappingcoverage flags
added_features.QN: base plus neural-solver features and shared coverageflags
added_features.aggregation: motiffrequency weighted mean lookup; QN/QE deterministic transforms ofQG; anygainis representation/regularization, notnewelectronicinformation
added_features.observables: forU=4,8: energies/4 atN=2,3,4; correlationenergies(EU-E0)/4 atN=2,3,4; curvature(E4+E2-2E3)/4.14features; energiesonly avoid ambiguous degeneracy-dependentcorrelators. NQS uses its own U0energies. Curvatureisfinitecluster shell/pair diagnostic, notSCevidence.

attribution.adaptation: Lattice JW ordering parity times signed permutation-invariant attention coefficient; exact configuration-sum Rayleigh loss, not continuum generalized-Slater VMC or an author-code reproduction.

authorization: User explicitly requested implementation and comparison on Storm and Hurricane; new experiment, separate from R001 normal-state pilot and read-only R006 review.

exploratory_effect_rule.hurricane: QN-Q0 pointmacroPUAUC>=0.02 and lower95%>0; QN-QG lower95%>0 needed to credit transform beyond graphcontrol.
exploratory_effect_rule.storm: QN-Q0 pointMAE<=-0.03K and upper95%<0; claimobservedpracticalpointgainonly. QN-QG upper95%<0 needed to credit transform beyond graphcontrol.

hurricane.baseline: H7R0 fresh common-run with samefamily/chemsystem exclusion,inner3system folds,alpha grid,pairweights
hurricane.secondary: equalfamily recall at20%budget; no calibratedpSC or true-negativeclaims

paired_bootstrap.unit: chemical-system clusters; fixed heldoutpredictions; same resampling sharedcomparisons

graphlets.cache: exact source byteSHA plus mappingversion; complete Hamiltonian bank keys
graphlets.canonicalization: minimum6-edge bitmask over all24 vertex permutations;11 graph classes fixed independently of materialcohort
graphlets.centers: all atoms; no species or label-dependent selection
graphlets.definition: central site plus three nearest periodic neighbor images; average all choices tied at third distance; central-star edges forced, neighbor-neighbor edge if distance<=1.15*largest central-neighbor distance
graphlets.failures: unknown/missing; never reconstruct graphs from19geometry summaries; fail real comparison unless eachcohort has>=95% structural coverage; identical cohort allarms; missingmasked train-onlyimputation
graphlets.image_identity: (site index, integer periodic shift), not unique species

hamiltonian.family: all11 unlabeled simple undirected four-site graphs, fixed one orbital per site, open graph clusters
hamiltonian.mapping_limit: Unfitted dimensionless structural surrogate, not the actual material electronic Hamiltonian; no electron-phonon lambda or material Tc is computed.

predecessor.change_reason: Improve variational solver convergence before any material outcome is observed; allphysicsaccuracy,data,downstreamdecisiongates unchanged.

solver.architecture: one self-attention layer,width16,twoheads; occupied(site,spin)onehot tokens; invariant sum pooling;signed real amplitude;JW parity;duplicate orbitals zero
solver.ed: independent complete matrix diagonalization; ground-space projector fidelity handles degeneracy
solver.failure: any nonconverged/missing bank entry prevents all real downstream neural comparisons; ED never substitutes for failedNN
solver.loss: exact normalized Rayleigh quotient; no targets or exact energies in loss
solver.optimizer: Adam with cosine learning-rate schedule .01 to .00001 over2000steps
solver.selection: lowest finite variational energy among two fixed seeds, no downstream label access
solver.timing_pilot: compile+20steps largest36-state case; stop if fullbank projection>1200seconds; do not shrink bank after seeing downstream outcomes
